628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.bullet_1: Warrior is the basket's lowest-cost producer: all-longwall Mines 4 and 7 plus Blue Creek, shipping through Mobile. Q2 FY2026 cash cost was $92.53/t, down 9% y/y on Blue Creek mix and the 45X credit; LTM gross margin 30.5% vs 10.0% at AMR.
628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.bullet_2: Blue Creek was funded without new equity and adds 5.0M of the 13.0-14.0M short tons guided for FY2026. With that capex done, Q2 FY2026 FCF was $103.4M and net cash $87M; above the $350-400M cash target, buybacks become the lever.
628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.bullet_3: Valuation builds on the two pillars above: 16M short tons with Blue Creek ramped, at a ~$118/t margin ($213 2023 price less a $95 cost the low-cost base can hold), gives $1,843M EBITDA; at 4.5x, $158.72 per share, +73% vs $91.94.
628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.claim_1: Cash cost of sales (FOB port) stays at or below $100/t in Q3 FY2026 and through the H2 FY2026 longwall moves (Q2 FY2026: $92.53).
628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.claim_2: FY2027 guidance sets Blue Creek at 6.0M short tons or more and total at 14.5M or more, and cash passes $400M or a buyback or special dividend comes by the Q4 FY2026 report.
628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.claim_3: Quarterly cash margin per short ton keeps rising from $45.29 (Q2 FY2026) toward the ~$118 Recovery level, taking EBITDA from $440M LTM toward $1,843M.
628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.breaks_1: Cash cost above $100/t in Q3 or Q4 FY2026, or one longwall event removing 25% or more of production.
628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.breaks_2: FY2027 guidance leaves Blue Creek below 6.0M short tons, or cash exceeds $400M with no buyback or dividend by Q4 FY2026.
628a7d32-59b8-487b-9902-5a8dabfb84e5.breaks_3: Net selling price stays near $135/t through 2030 (Bear case): EBITDA about $515M and value of $45.54, below today's price.

d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.bullet_1: Alpha is the basket's high-cost name (Met cost $103.07/t vs $118.71/t realization, Q2 FY2026), so its edge is flexibility: small mines, its own blending terminal, low-vol Kingston Wildcat tons and 3.8M domestic tons committed for 2026.
d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.bullet_2: It can wait out the trough without dilution: net cash $327M and $447.8M liquidity at Q2 FY2026, despite a fifth straight loss. Buybacks cut diluted shares from 18.9M (FY2021) to 14.6M (FY2023); about 12.7M today.
d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.bullet_3: Valuation builds on the two pillars above: 14M t from the flexible base at a ~$74/t margin ($179.40 FY2023 realization less $105 cost) gives $990M EBITDA; with net cash and 12.7M shares, 4.5x gives $377.13, +117% vs $173.82.
d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.claim_1: Met cost of coal sales at or below $103.00/t in Q4 FY2026 as Kingston Wildcat ramps, and 3.8M or more 2027 domestic tons committed at an average of at least $128.17/t.
d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.claim_2: Total liquidity stays at or above $400M at the end of Q3 and Q4 FY2026 (Q2 FY2026: $447.8M), with no equity issuance and the share count at or below 12.7M.
d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.claim_3: Met margin per ton rises from $15.64 (Q2 FY2026) toward ~$74 on about 14M t, taking EBITDA from $121M LTM toward the $990M Recovery figure.
d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.breaks_1: Met cost above $107.00/t in Q4 FY2026, or 2027 domestic commitments below 3.8M t or priced under $128.17/t.
d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.breaks_2: Liquidity below $400M at the end of Q3 or Q4 FY2026, or any equity issuance.
d6e203ec-c789-432a-9ab9-2a6c36b2f6e0.breaks_3: Met realization stays near $120/t through 2030 (Bear case): EBITDA about $169M and value of $75.63 per share.

bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.bullet_1: CNR is the only member that is roughly half thermal: PAMC high-CV thermal, PRB and the Core Marine Terminal are 61% of Bear-case segment EBITDA, cushioning the trough, while the Leer complex (8.7M coking tons contracted for 2026) carries the met upside.
bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.bullet_2: CNR pays out: $360M returned since February 2025, $68M in Q2 FY2026, under a ~75%-of-FCF framework, while keeping the balance sheet about net-debt neutral (net cash $26M, LTM FCF yield 5.7%).
bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.bullet_3: Valuation builds on the two pillars above: $4.27B revenue at 41.7%, CNR's own best LTM margin of the last 3 years (set by pre-merger CONSOL), gives $1,780M EBITDA; with net cash held, 4.5x gives $162.02 per share, +77% vs $91.36.
bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.claim_1: Met cash cost stays at or below $91/t in Q3 and Q4 FY2026 (Q2 FY2026: $85.65), and FY2027 guidance sets coking sales midpoint at 8.5M t or more and cash cost at $90/t or less.
bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.claim_2: Shareholder returns of at least $100M in Q3 FY2026 (Q2 FY2026: $68M), with net debt held at or below zero.
bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.claim_3: EBITDA margin rises from 16.9% LTM (Q2 FY2026) toward ~41.7% on revenue near $4.27B, taking EBITDA from $723M LTM, which includes $125M of insurance, toward $1,780M.
bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.breaks_1: Met cash cost above $91/t in Q3 or Q4 FY2026, or another Leer or Leer South longwall event.
bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.breaks_2: Q3 FY2026 returns below the $68M of Q2 FY2026, or net debt turning positive to fund returns.
bca79e2f-a68a-45a1-a61d-d850b18fb5ef.breaks_3: Met and thermal margins stay at Q2 FY2026 levels (Bear case): EBITDA about $623M and value of $57.05 per share.
